newsitem.title: UK: UK concerned at stg's effect on industry-minister.
newsitem.headline: UK concerned at stg's effect on industry-minister.

text.p: The British government is concerned about the impact of the high level of sterling on UK industry, Helen Liddell, Economic Secretary to the Treasury, told parliament on Thursday.

Asked by Labour member Denis MacShane whether she shared his concern that sterling was too high and was harming industry, Liddell replied: "I very much share your concern about the impact that the pound is having on manufacturing and other industry."
Liddell blamed the high pound on "the failure of the previous government to effectively tighten monetary policy".
"We are living with the consequences of a government that was more concerned with its own backbenchers than with actually governing this country," she said.
Members of parliament who do not hold ministerial posts or opposition party spokesmanships are known as backbenchers.
